title: DeepUnfolding Agent：经典-量子自适应控制API平台
summary: 该论文提出DeepUnfolding Agent，一个基于FastAPI的schema驱动平台，将深度展开自适应控制作为外部服务暴露。通过策略注册、诊断适配、控制器工厂、安全守卫等模块，实现控制器智能与任务执行的解耦，支持经典、量子感知、混合及IBM量子执行路径，提升复用性与可复现性。
summary_en: This paper presents DeepUnfolding Agent, a schema-driven FastAPI platform that exposes deep unfolded adaptive control as an external software service. It decouples controller intelligence from task-specific execution via a strategy registry, diagnostic-to-state adapter, controller factory, safety guard, and feedback update path, supporting classical, quantum-aware, hybrid, Qiskit Aer, and IBM Quantum execution pathways for reusable and traceable optimization workflows.
